svg.title: DualMind Arena — AI model evaluation platform
svg.desc: DualMind Arena — AI model evaluation platform. Status: Live at arena.dualmindlab.tech. Problem: Public AI benchmarks are easy to game: cherry-picked prompts, brand bias, results nobody can audit. Approach: Blind head-to-head battles on real community prompts. Model identities stay hidden until the vote is locked. Highlights: Cloudflare AI Gateway routes every LLM call — rate limits, caching, per-request logs; Stateless .NET Web API behind Cloudflare CDN; scaling out is a config change; Supabase (PostgreSQL) on purpose: leaderboard ranking needs relational SQL; Real-time login anomaly detection with IP capture, risk scoring and owner alerts. Stack: Azure, .NET Web API, Vanilla JS, Supabase, Cloudflare CDN, AI Gateway, GitHub Actions.
